messages:
maya: Hey product/eng — quick brain dump: wondering about UX for a 'slimline' per-route view that shows per-model rows and quick filters. Main questions: who 'owns' saved views (route team vs model team vs global), and how do we surface quota/expected cost up front? :thinking:

ben: I'd vote saved view ownership defaults to route owners, with option to mark org-shared. Route teams are the primary consumers, and it avoids cluttering a global list.

jamie: Agree re default, but we need a lightweight permission model + audit trail so we can nuke noisy org-shared views later. Also think about autosuggesting 'owned by' when creating.

olivia: On quota/cost: show an "effective quota" pill in the header that combines route quota + per-model limits and indicates potential overage. Example: "Route quota: 100k req/mo · Model budget: 40k" — hover to reveal breakdown. :money_with_wings:

maya: Implementation thought: saved view metadata should include scope, ownerId, routeId?, modelId?, visibility. Telemetry must capture view_id on any console queries. Draft API idea:

```http
POST /api/console/saved_views
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name":"Errors + latency by model",
  "scope":"route",
  "routeId":"route_abc",
  "modelId":"rw-ggml-3b",
  "filters":[...],
  "visibility":"team"
}
```

ben: One engineering snag — routing fallbacks. Views can pin a model but runtime may fall back to a compatible cheaper variant; telemetry attribution will be confusing if we only record requested_model. We need both requested_model and served_model logged.

sam: +1. We already log served_model on traces. For saved views we can surface a 'served model mix' column: small sparkline + percentages so teams know how often fallbacks happened.

jamie: UX decision about editing scope during rollouts: if a global/team view is edited mid-rollout, we should version saved views (immutable history) and show which version was active for which time window. Tie this to the feature flag rollout so support can correlate incidents.

olivia: For cost estimates, proposal: compute 'estimated tokens' per row using a sampled distribution from telemetry + usage per route, then show an inline cost estimate. Might call a sampling endpoint like "/api/console/estimate?route=...&filters=...".

maya: Implementation checklist (rough):
- API: create/update/list saved_views with scope & metadata
- Telemetry: tag console queries with view_id + requested_model + served_model
- UI: header pill for effective quota + cost estimate, served-model mix column
- Permissions: default to route owner, support org/team visibility + audit logs
- Versioning: immutable view history + diff UI
- Rollout: feature flag `slimlineViews` for canary

deploy-bot: Feature flag `slimlineViews` set to OFF in prod, ON in staging.

ben: I'll prototype the API + telemetry tags next week, aim for a tiny proof-of-concept by Friday.

jamie: I'll own permissions model + versioning docs and sync with security. Putting it on the backlog, will sync Wed.

olivia: I'll mock up the header pill + served-model mix UI and a compact cost widget, share Figma.

maya: Great — follow-ups: jamie/ben/olivia to post short RFC links into this thread when ready. Quick Figma proto: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/slimline-views (proto) :thumbsup:
